19K likes, 144 comments - arihantbaidofficial on September 18, 2026: "Most budget friendly country in Europe and you don’t even know about it !

This is Kosovo 🇽🇰 a country younger than the Gen Z’s!
A budget friendly country for travellers to explore for a couple of days and experience the warmth of its lovely people 

Pristina, the capital city, Prizren and Peje are some of the most visited cities.

#europe #indiatravel #kosovo".
